changes.title: Export filtered ledger entries
changes.customer_impact: Account administrators can export the currently filtered ledger-entry list as a CSV file.
changes.availability: Available to all paid plans from 2026-11-15.
changes.prerequisites: The user must have the Account Administrator role.
changes.limitations: CSV format only. A single export can contain up to 10000 rows.
changes.internal_notes: Do not mention the internal export worker implementation.

changes.title: Show currency in account activity filters
changes.customer_impact: The account activity filter now displays the account currency next to the account name.

changes.title: Correct duplicate-entry warning
changes.customer_impact: The duplicate-entry warning is now shown when the same idempotency key is reused with a different request body.
changes.availability: Available to all API customers from 2026-11-15.
changes.limitations: This change does not prevent duplicates when clients use a new idempotency key for each retry.
changes.internal_notes: Do not claim broader duplicate prevention.

changes.title: Enable scheduled exports
changes.internal_notes: Exclude from this release pending approval.
